note: source:compact adds the invariant-7 advisory naming the latest checkpoint and asking for a fresh terminal. The path it names must be the one an operator can OPEN: wv_latest_checkpoint already returns a project-relative path (.wave/checkpoints/<file>), so a clause that prefixes it again renders .wave/checkpoints/.wave/checkpoints/<file> — a path that does not exist. Asserting the filename alone cannot see that, which is how fix round 1's reworded clause shipped it; stdout_absent pins the doubled prefix and reason_contains now pins the whole path rather than its tail.
